claim: UInt32 values from 128 through 255 are no longer emitted with the compact uint8 representation. Removing the byte.MaxValue branch sends them to TryWriteUInt16, so for example 200 is serialized as CD 00 C8 (three bytes) instead of CC C8 (two bytes). This changes the wire bytes and regresses payload size for an entire commonly used value range; it can also break consumers or persisted data that rely on the serializer's established byte representation.
